name: @mcp-graph-workflow/agent-graph-flow
stderr:
Usage: agent-graph-flow [options] [command]

Agente SWE autônomo, local-first e token-frugal: PRD vira grafo de execução
persistente, TDD obrigatório, custo de token brutalmente baixo.

Options:
  -v, --version   output the version number
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  import          Import a PRD file into the graph
  phase           Manage lifecycle phase detection
  next            Suggest the next task to work on
  decompose       Decompose tasks into subtasks
  check           Run DoD validation checks
  autopilot       Run autonomous sprint execution
  run             One-shot ad-hoc execution
  model           Manage tier-router model config
  stats           Show graph statistics
  metrics         Show token and cost metrics
  login           Authenticate with GitHub Copilot
  logout          Clear authentication
  init            Initialize a project graph
  daemon          Manage the local daemon service
  doctor          Run environment diagnostics
  gc              Run garbage collection
  skill           Manage lifecycle skills
  profile         Manage config profiles
  principles      Manage governing principles
  generate-prd    Generate a PRD from an idea
  build           Full lifecycle cycle with gates
  quality         Run quality gate 95/95
  ui              Start minimal web progress UI
  provider        Manage LLM providers
  harness         Run harnessability scan
  constitution    Manage project constitution
  plugin          Manage plugin extensions
  preset          Manage workflow presets
  spec            Generate and validate specs
  help [command]  display help for command
